snippet.title: Destruction 4.0 Trailer - ShatterRush
snippet.description:
Wishlist and try the Pre-Alpha on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668330/ShatterRush?utm_source=youtubetrailer-destructionv4

ShatterRush is a multiplayer parkour FPS where fluid movement meets massive mechs in fully destructible levels. Wallrun, grapple, and smash through cover to outplay your foes in kinetic, high-speed combat as the map changes with every fight.

Join over 100k Pre-Alpha testers and help us shape the future of the game!

SUPPORT THE GAME: https://www.patreon.com/c/TetraStudios

Special thanks to the UTS Playmakers for helping with some of the footage!
